name: Apostles
overview: The apostles were specially chosen by Jesus to be closely associated with Him, as seen when He called fishermen like Simon Peter and Andrew to follow Him and become 'fishers of men' (Matthew 4:18-20). Their immediate response to leave their livelihoods and follow Jesus (Matthew 4:20, 4:22) demonstrates the unique commission given to them. Despite their close relationship with Christ, the apostles often struggled to fully grasp His mission and the nature of the kingdom He came to establish, reflecting their human limitations before Pentecost.
